default_invocation.description: Release planning can be discussed compactly, but production-impacting release/deploy execution requires explicit approval plus machine-readable release evidence.
default_invocation.expected_return: Release readiness, approval refs, checks, release/rollback evidence, residual risks, and recommended next action.

machine_readable_invocation.use_when: Required for release/deploy execution or durable release evidence; optional only for preliminary non-impacting release discussion.

handoff_json.use_when: Release/deploy work always needs durable machine-readable release evidence.
